---
title: "Validation Gates"
---

Validation is part of the research method. Checks protect syntax, schema freshness, data integrity, and methodological guardrails.

## Standard Check Set

Run these before commits and before publishing:

```bash
uv run ruff check .
uv run pytest
uv run fspp schema check
uv run fspp validate
```

## What The Checks Protect

- `ruff check`: Python style, imports, modernization, and common bug patterns.
- `pytest`: unit and guardrail tests.
- `fspp schema check`: checked-in JSON Schemas match the current Pydantic models.
- `fspp validate`: canonical scaffold data and referential integrity.

## Research-Sensitive Changes

Changes touching research data, schemas, codebook semantics, or source boundaries require an explicit account of research, migration, and reproducibility consequences.

AI/model review may flag issues, but it may not overwrite reference annotations.
